rows.pot: Unclaimed accrued US digital mechanicals under the blanket licence, 2021 usage onward
rows.who_can_claim: Songwriters, publishers and administrators whose songs earned US digital audio mechanicals that the MLC received but could not match or pay out.
rows.how_to_claim: Use the MLC's tools to register songs, claim missing shares and propose matches for unmatched recordings. Money still unclaimed is later shared out by market share.
rows.rule: The MLC plans to start market-share payouts in April 2027, beginning with usage from January 2021 and moving forward a month per payout. This is a start date, not a deadline.
rows.cost: Free to join, per the MLC

rows.pot: Historical unmatched US streaming mechanicals from 2007 to 2020
rows.who_can_claim: Owners of musical works used in US streaming before 2021 whose use the services could not match to a copyright owner.
rows.how_to_claim: Join the MLC, register your works, then use its claiming and matching tools to find missing shares and propose links to unmatched uses. Matched money is paid with interest.
rows.rule: As of November 2026 the MLC says its market-share process for what stays unmatched has not begun. It gives no claim cut-off date on the page.
rows.cost: Free to join, per the MLC

rows.pot: US digital mechanicals held for rightsholders who have not yet joined the MLC
rows.who_can_claim: Rightsholders who are not yet MLC Members and who find their own name, or the name they collect under, in the lookup.
rows.how_to_claim: Search your name in the Missing Member Lookup. If it appears, sign up as an MLC Member to collect the digital audio mechanicals owed to you.
rows.rule: The lookup leaves out historical unmatched royalties, so a hit shows only part of what may be owed. The page states no claim cut-off.
rows.cost: Free lookup and free to join

rows.holder: Copyright owners, usually publishers, paid MLC unclaimed money
rows.pot: The songwriter's share of any unclaimed accrued royalties a publisher receives from the MLC
rows.who_can_claim: Songwriters whose works a publisher licenses or administers for US digital mechanicals, or their authorised agents.
rows.how_to_claim: When your publisher or administrator receives an MLC unclaimed distribution, ask for the payment or credit due to you and the usage behind it. If it is disputed, involve a music lawyer.
rows.rule: By statute the share follows reported usage and is never under 50% of what the owner got for that songwriter's works or shares, whatever the contract says.
rows.cost: The statute sets no fee or claim process

rows.pot: US digital performance royalties for unregistered artists and sound recording owners
rows.who_can_claim: Unregistered recording artists, performers and sound recording owners whose recordings were played on US non-interactive services such as SiriusXM and Pandora.
rows.how_to_claim: Use the search on SoundExchange's page to see if you appear on one of its unregistered lists. Then register for free and claim your recordings in SX Direct.
rows.rule: The page says registration is required to be paid. It gives no time limit for claiming, so check with SoundExchange before assuming money is safe.

rows.pot: Uses by online music services in Canada of recordings or work shares that CMRRA has not yet matched
rows.who_can_claim: Rightsholders who own or control musical works and hold an approved CMRRA Direct account. The page is written as a guide for publishers.
rows.how_to_claim: Apply for a CMRRA Direct account (approval may need as long as 3 business days), open Unclaimed Works, match recordings to your works and add missing ownership shares.
rows.rule: After CMRRA verifies the submission, its quarterly invoicing covers past and current use. The page gives no claim cut-off date.
rows.cost: No fee stated on the page

rows.pot: UK recorded-music royalties for performers missing from a recording's line-up
rows.who_can_claim: Performers on a recording in PPL's repertoire that was played in public or broadcast, if the performer's residence or citizenship, or where they recorded, qualifies.
rows.how_to_claim: Join PPL as a performer and, if you are not on a track's line-up, claim in myPPL. PPL may ask for evidence. If the track itself is missing, ask its rightsholder to add it.
rows.rule: The page states no claim deadline. It says the UK right to equitable remuneration through PPL runs 70 years from the recording being made or released.
rows.cost: No fee stated on the page

usc-115.publisher: United States Congress (Cornell LII copy of the U.S. Code)
usc-115.title: 17 U.S.C. 115: Scope of exclusive rights in nondramatic musical works: Compulsory license for making and distributing phonorecords
usc-115.support: (d)(3)(J)(iv) Songwriter payments: owners receiving unclaimed accrued royalties pay or credit songwriters by reported usage, notwithstanding any agreement, never less than 50 percent attributable to that songwriter.
usc-115.edition: Title 17, section 115, as shown by LII

mlc-unclaimed.title: Unclaimed Accrued Royalties
mlc-unclaimed.support: Defines unclaimed accrued royalties as unmatched plus unclaimed; intends to begin distributions in April 2027 through market share, starting with January 2021 blanket usage; dashboard for 2021 usage.

mlc-historical.title: Historical Royalties
mlc-historical.support: 2007 to 2020 streaming; 21 DSPs; liability limit for transfer by 15 Feb 2021; about $427M cut to about $397M; first matched payouts given as May 2022 and June 2022; market share for remainder not begun (Nov 2026 data).
mlc-historical.edition: Dashboard text states data current as of November 2026

mlc-missing-members.title: Missing Member Lookup
mlc-missing-members.support: Searchable list of rightsholders not yet Members who may be owed US digital audio mechanicals; excludes historical unmatched royalties; Get Started block says connecting with the MLC is free.

mlc-pr-2026-09.title: The MLC Holds Annual Membership Meeting: Highlights More Than $4.2 Billion in Total Royalties Distributed and Announces Date of First Monthly Market Share Distribution
mlc-pr-2026-09.support: 30 September 2026: April 2027 start, one month at a time from January 2021; pro rata by DSP and offering; more than six years of matching; nearly $5B processed, $4.2B distributed; $239M historical; 100,000 Members; 60M works.

sx-owed.title: Artists, Labels & Producers
sx-owed.support: 'Are you owed royalties?' section: registration needed to be paid; search tool; four status lists; registering free; SX Direct free, used to search and claim recordings; no time limit. Read with WebFetch.

cmrra-unclaimed.title: Unclaimed Works Portal for Online Music Services
cmrra-unclaimed.support: CMRRA Direct account needed (approval up to 3 business days); match recordings and add missing shares via the Unclaimed Works menu; quarterly invoicing for past and current use; no fee or deadline. Read with WebFetch.

ppl-performers.title: Performers
ppl-performers.support: Performer claim via myPPL if not on line-up; may need evidence; missing track: ask rightsholder; repertoire and played or broadcast; qualification by residence, citizenship or place; UK 70-year ER right. Read with WebFetch.
